name: humans-md-spec-tools
description: Reference tools for the HUMANS.md spec: validator, withholding, group merge

scripts.test: node validate.mjs ../examples/*.md ../tests/schema-valid-but-withheld/*.md && node validate.mjs --expect-invalid ../tests/invalid/*.md && node withhold.mjs ../tests/withholding.json && node merge.mjs ../tests/group/team.json && node merge.mjs ../tests/group/incident-pair.json && node check-terms.mjs && node --test test.mjs
